questions.text: Nia wants nasi goreng. Which menu item should she point to?
questions.discussion: Fried rice berarti nasi goreng. Rice saja berarti nasi dalam konteks menu ini.

questions.text: Which word can complete the label “fried ___” for ayam goreng?
questions.discussion: Chicken berarti ayam. Digabung dengan fried, frasanya menjadi ayam goreng.

questions.text: Choose the pair that contains two drinks.
questions.discussion: Tea dan milk adalah minuman. Bread, rice, dan ice cream termasuk makanan.

questions.text: Which menu word means bakso?
questions.discussion: Meatballs berarti bakso. Di menu, bentuk jamak bisa dipakai untuk satu porsi berisi beberapa bakso.

questions.text: What does “banana” name on a snack card?
questions.discussion: Banana adalah nama buah pisang. Snack pada kartu menunjukkan makanan ringan.

questions.text: The menu lists tea, coffee, milk, and bread. Which item belongs under “Food”?
questions.discussion: Bread adalah roti. Tiga pilihan lain bisa dicantumkan di bagian minuman.

questions.text: Which spelling belongs on the es krim label?
questions.discussion: Ejaan yang benar terdiri dari dua kata, ice dan cream.

questions.text: Which note means “Aku suka mi”?
questions.discussion: I like menyatakan kesukaan penutur. Noodles adalah mi.

questions.text: Put “like / I / milk” in order to make a statement.
questions.discussion: Kalimat ini menaruh I sebagai subjek, lalu like, dan milk sebagai benda yang disukai.

questions.text: Choose the question that asks a friend about bread.
questions.discussion: Do you like memulai pertanyaan tentang kesukaan teman. Benda yang ditanyakan di sini adalah bread.

questions.text: Lina says, “Yes, I do.” What does “do” stand for when the question is “Do you like tea?”?
questions.discussion: Do dalam jawaban singkat menggantikan like tea dari pertanyaan sebelumnya.

questions.text: Adi asks, “Do you like fried chicken?” Beni likes it. How can Beni reply?
questions.discussion: Beni menyatakan kesukaan dirinya, jadi jawabannya memakai Yes dan I.

questions.text: Sita asks, “Do you like milk?” Ari does not like it. What can Ari say?
questions.discussion: Jawaban No, I don’t menyatakan bahwa penutur sendiri tidak menyukai susu.

questions.text: What does “it” refer to in this exchange? “I like coffee. Do you like it?”
questions.discussion: It merujuk kembali pada minuman yang baru disebut, yaitu coffee.

questions.text: “I like bread. I don’t like rice.” Which item does the speaker like?
questions.discussion: Kalimat pertama menyatakan suka roti. Kalimat kedua menyatakan tidak suka nasi.

questions.text: Rani says, “I don’t like tea. I like milk.” Which statement is true?
questions.discussion: Rani memilih susu sebagai minuman yang disukai. Don’t like hanya menjelaskan sikapnya terhadap teh.

questions.text: “Do you like bananas?” “Yes, I do. I like ice cream, too.” Which pair does the speaker like?
questions.discussion: Yes menjawab pertanyaan tentang pisang. Too menambahkan es krim pada daftar kesukaan.

questions.text: Ayu likes tea. Dito says, “I don’t like tea. I like coffee.” What is different?
options: Ayu likes coffee, and Dito likes tea.
Ayu likes tea, and Dito likes coffee.
questions.answer: Ayu likes tea, and Dito likes coffee.
questions.discussion: Kesukaan Ayu diberikan di kalimat awal. Dito menyebut kopi setelah menolak teh.

questions.text: Lala says, “I like noodles.” Which response says you share her preference?
questions.discussion: Too berarti juga. Jawaban ini menyebut kesukaan yang sama, yaitu mi.

questions.text: Choose the best opening question if the survey column is titled “Ice cream”.
questions.discussion: Untuk mengisi kolom tentang es krim, pewawancara perlu menanyakan kesukaan pada ice cream.

questions.text: A friend answers “No, I don’t” to “Do you like bread?” What goes in the bread column?
questions.discussion: No menandai jawaban negatif untuk roti. Jawaban teman sudah diketahui, jadi kolom tidak dikosongkan.

questions.text: Your survey note says “Mira: bananas — Yes; milk — No.” What can Mira say?
options: I like milk. I don’t like bananas.
I don’t like bananas or milk.
I like bananas. I don’t like milk.
questions.answer: I like bananas. I don’t like milk.
questions.discussion: Tanda Yes berlaku untuk pisang dan No untuk susu. Pernyataan dari sudut pandang Mira memakai I.

questions.text: Read the notes: “Dina — tea: Yes. Rio — tea: No. Tia — tea: Yes.” Which two children like tea?
questions.discussion: Hanya Dina dan Tia memiliki jawaban Yes pada catatan teh.

questions.text: “Do you like fried rice?” “No, I don’t. I like fried chicken.” What can you record?
options: Fried rice: No. Fried chicken: Yes.
Fried rice: Yes. Fried chicken: No.
Fried rice: Yes. Fried chicken: Yes.
Fried rice: No. Fried chicken: No.
questions.answer: Fried rice: No. Fried chicken: Yes.
questions.discussion: No menjawab pertanyaan tentang nasi goreng, sedangkan I like menyatakan kesukaan pada ayam goreng.

questions.text: Ana says, “I like bread and milk.” Which line has the same meaning?
options: I like bread. I don’t like milk.
I like milk. I don’t like bread.
I don’t like bread or milk.
I like bread. I like milk, too.
questions.answer: I like bread. I like milk, too.
questions.discussion: And menghubungkan dua benda yang sama-sama disukai. Too menyatakan tambahan dengan makna setara.

questions.text: Complete the question: “___ you like tea?”
questions.discussion: Do diletakkan di depan you untuk membentuk pertanyaan kesukaan.

questions.text: Complete the answer: “Yes, I ___.”
questions.discussion: Do melengkapi jawaban singkat positif untuk pertanyaan Do you like ...?

questions.text: Complete the note about food you dislike: “I ___ like coffee.”
questions.discussion: Don’t diletakkan sebelum like agar maknanya menjadi tidak suka.

questions.text: Which sentence has the right word order and punctuation for a question?
questions.discussion: Pertanyaan berpola Do + you + like + benda dan diakhiri tanda tanya.

questions.text: Which sentence has the right capital letter and ending mark for a statement?
questions.discussion: Kata ganti I selalu ditulis dengan huruf kapital. Pernyataan ini diakhiri titik.

questions.text: “I like Mi Aceh.” Which part names the food?
questions.discussion: Mi Aceh adalah nama hidangan. I menyebut penutur dan like menyatakan kesukaan.

questions.text: Bima wrote “I like bread” below a drawing of milk. He wants to keep the drawing. Which word should replace “bread”?
questions.discussion: Agar kalimat cocok dengan gambar susu, kata untuk makanan diganti dengan milk.

questions.text: A menu shows only fried chicken and meatballs. Which choice is available for someone who likes bakso?
questions.discussion: Meatballs berarti bakso dan tercantum pada menu. Fried chicken adalah ayam goreng.

questions.text: One friend likes tea. The other says, “I like tea, too.” Which survey summary fits?
options: Only the first friend likes tea.
Only the second friend likes tea.
questions.discussion: Too berarti juga, sehingga kesukaan pada teh berlaku untuk keduanya.

questions.text: “I like rice.” “Do you like fried rice?” “I don’t know.” What do we know for sure?
questions.discussion: Kesukaan pada nasi dinyatakan langsung. I don’t know tidak menetapkan jawaban untuk nasi goreng.
